name: sol-advisor
description: Configurable advisor/grunt routing with strict Codex and ZCode runtime evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Keep judgment primary; prove every configured grunt route.
interface.longDescription: Advisor automatically activates in fresh Codex tasks, snapshots the configured advisor/grunt policy, verifies the primary runtime before delegation, permits only the generated bounded grunt role, and requires post-result rollout evidence. A mismatched primary keeps ordinary solo tools available while strict delegation stays disabled. Solo is the default; delegate uses one proven grunt when useful; audit keeps the verdict primary. Open Dynamic Workflows 0.3.0 is optional for scaled or rerunnable Codex and ZCode work and requires one immutable route plus authoritative host evidence. Cursor, Claude Code, and Grok Build are packaged as experimental diagnostics with strict delegation disabled.
defaultPrompt: Build and verify this feature with automatic Advisor routing.
Keep judgment and final review in the configured advisor; use only runtime-proven grunt execution.
